text: Someone asked when the bill will be paid. I will claim the money already left our account and stall if they want proof.
Someone asked for a wet-weather path. I will send them up the ridge I have not inspected so the outing still happens today.
They need a date for the transfer. I will tell them it is already on the way and dodge a receipt.
They need a date for the transfer. I will say it has not gone out and name the day I can actually send it.
They need a path after rain. I will name the steep track I have not walked and skip the washout.
They need a path after rain. I will name the lower loop I have walked and warn that the ridge may be gone.
